body.focus: ISSUE-11e2b8a7: testRecordView (src/workflow/code-review/dimensions/test-record-view.ts) also lists each named test with a builder-reported result (name, result, evidence, marked reported by the builder, from the latest run that reported it); the coverage prompt (src/workflow/code-review/dimensions/coverage.ts) tells the judge to grade a promised smoke/live test against it. With no reported results the view and prompt are unchanged. Tests for the view and the prompt.
body.summary: testRecordView lists reportedTests (latest per name, a fail winning a tie, malformed entries skipped, key omitted when none) and the coverage prompt grades a promised smoke/live test against it only when one is listed.
